What `garage repair --reset` would do:
  1. copy the file to ~/.config/garage/preferences.toml.bak-<timestamp>, a name
     that is never reused -- an existing backup is never overwritten
  2. write a fresh preferences.toml carrying the schema stamp
     (preferences_version = 5) and nothing else, which is factory state: the
     file holds your departures from the shipped defaults, so no departures
     means every setting follows what Garage ships
  3. load it back and report whether the result is healthy

Nothing else is touched. displays.toml, keybindings.toml and
workspace-blocks.toml are records rather than settings and each has its own
way back already: an unconfirmed display layout reverts itself after 15s,
the rescue shortcuts in config/binds.lua never read keybindings.toml, and a
workspace block that cannot be read is handed out again.

Nothing has been changed. Re-run as `garage repair --reset` to act.
